relations.text: 中国の華泰保険集団の支配持分を取得(2025年末に約87.2%)
relations.text_en: Took control of Huatai Insurance Group in China; about 87.2% at end-2025

source.label: Chubb 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: At December 31, 2025, our ownership interest in Huatai Group was approximately 87.2 percent.

relations.text: タイのLMG Insuranceを3.21億ドルで買収(2025年4月)
relations.text_en: Bought LMG Insurance in Thailand for $321 million (April 2025)

source.label: Chubb 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On April 1, 2025 , we completed the acquisition of LMG Insurance in Thailand for $ 321 million

companies.name: リバティ保険(ベトナム)

relations.text: ベトナムのLiberty Insuranceを買収(2026年2月)

source.label: Chubb 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 2, 2026, we completed the acquisition of Liberty Insurance in Vietnam

relations.text: ペット保険のHealthy PawsをAonから約3億ドルで買い取った(2024年5月)
relations.text_en: Bought pet insurer Healthy Paws from Aon for about $300 million (May 2024)

source.label: Chubb 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On May 31, 2024 , we acquired the business of Healthy Paws Pet Insurance LLC, a managing general agent specializing in pet insurance, from Aon plc for approximately $ 300 million in cash.

relations.text: 従業員向け福利厚生で最も重要な契約先の一つ(UnitedHealthcareと並ぶ)
relations.text_en: One of the two most significant contracts in its employee benefits package, with UnitedHealthcare

source.label: Insperity 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We consider our contracts with UnitedHealthcare ("United") and the Chubb Group of Insurance Companies ("Chubb") to be the most significant elements of our employee benefits package

relations.text: ADPの労災保険子会社がチャブと再保険契約(保険料2.78億ドル)
relations.text_en: ADP's workers' compensation unit buys reinsurance from Chubb ($278 million premium)

source.label: ADP 10-K(2025年6月期)
source.quote: ADP Indemnity paid a premium of $278 million in July 2025, to enter into a reinsurance agreement with Chubb to cover substantially all losses incurred by ADP Indemnity for fiscal 2026 policy year
